constraints: Binary databases cannot be compiled with this command.
Cannot be called while another compilation is already running (e.g. one launched from the Compiler window).
Components referenced via options.components must already be compiled (binary components are supported).
Passing an empty collection in options.targets performs a syntax check only, without compiling.
options.plugins is only honored with the projectFile syntax (not the host-project syntax).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Compiles the current host project (using Structure Settings compiler options, optionally overridden by options).

discriminatedBy.rule: Omitted -- compiles the currently opened host project.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Compiles the specified .4DProject file instead of the current host project (using Structure Settings compiler options, optionally overridden by options).

discriminatedBy.rule: Passed as a 4D.File -- compiles that project file instead of the current host project.
